title: 瑞联银行Casanova：地产拖累消费，K型修复还要多久？
speaker: Carlos Casanova

segments.en: They are clearly trying to put a floor on the contraction in real estate investment I think that is the other part of the stimulus announced yesterday
segments.zh: 他们显然在试图为地产领域的收缩托底，我认为这是昨天宣布的刺激措施的另一部分。

segments.en: that's going to definitely help with consumer sentiment 60 percent of household wealth you will hear this a lot from the private banks is linked to the real estate market
segments.zh: 这肯定会提振消费者信心。你会经常从私人银行听到，家庭财富的60%与地产市场相关。

segments.en: and so until you put a floor on that contraction in home prices households are now going to feel the need to spend more
segments.zh: 因此，除非为居住成本的下行压力托底，否则家庭目前不会感到需要增加支出。

segments.en: and so that could help into in terms of developing that consumption we are going to see stronger retail sales numbers coming out of October
segments.zh: 这可能有助于促进消费，我们将看到10月零售销售数据走强。

segments.en: we've merged mid-autumn festival and also the national day holiday that's right so it's going to be a little bit of a sequential pickup as well
segments.zh: 中秋和国庆假期合并，没错，所以也会出现一些环比回升。

segments.en: and that's going to help with the numbers before year end but ultimately until structural reform is implemented
segments.zh: 这将有助于年底前的数据，但最终除非结构性改革落地。

segments.en: we are not going to see a material change in China in the structure of China's economy which means that k-shaped recovery is going to remain in place
segments.zh: 否则中国经济结构不会出现实质性变化，这意味着K型修复仍将持续。

segments.en: So how would you classify this stimulus campaign that we just got I mean is it just enough to at least reach the annual growth target
segments.zh: 那么你如何归类我们刚刚获得的这轮刺激？我的意思是，它是否至少足以达到年度增长目标？

segments.en: can it do much more in terms of the leveraging of households and the like or even just turn the tide when it comes to investment as well
segments.zh: 它在家庭杠杆等方面能做得更多吗，甚至扭转相关投入的势头？

segments.en: I would categorize this as incremental support definitely more stimulus more fiscal stimulus than monetary stimulus as I was mentioning
segments.zh: 我会将其归类为增量支持，正如我提到的，肯定是更多刺激、更多财政刺激而非货币刺激。
